claim_boundary: Control artifact only. No train-support, strict eval, Level-3, patch-trace, repair, or sealed eval row is admitted.

hard_separation.level3_closed_loop_rows: must include state_before, action, observation/verifier, state_delta, stop/continue with same-source lineage
hard_separation.qc_candidates: candidate records only; cannot count toward 500
hard_separation.repair_rows: must prove buggy/failing and fixed/passing under same verifier
hard_separation.train_support_rows: admitted bounded/structured support only; not proof of frontier or repair

next_source_priority: non-Web selected-test roots with local focused verifier proof
Open-SWE QC candidates only after safe semantic extraction and deterministic admission
repair-grade before/fail after/pass triples when same-source proof exists
sealed transition slice construction separate from train-support ledger

plateau_caps.web_stop_condition: Stop Web mining after two consecutive PASS/PASS_TO_PASS-only batches with no FAIL_TO_PASS, no patch-effect proof, and no new repo family.

known_pitfalls_to_eliminate: executor-level blockers diverging from row-level blockers
command_hash_only refs that are raw commands rather than hashes
root_index modulo balancing without target-position audit
dependency paths visible in source/test evidence
PASS_TO_PASS selected-test support counted as repair proof
silent skip of missing configured source/test files
row_invariants: non-empty full-length test_hash_refs excluding dependency/vendor/generated paths
input_text exposes only opaque option labels, not semantic ids or target values
missing evidence routes to blocked_rows, not partial admission
